hamlet_context.purpose: actual hamlet PNG replacing the base center of a correctly gated forest-clearing fixture; graphics-only scale/context review

limitations: Recurring crown neighborhoods remain visible at larger patch scale; four crown shapes and periodic template are provisional.
Summer currently reads as open mixed woodland, not closed canopy. Full-map density, variation and unit readability need review.
Forest/base contexts cover grass or snow only; other ground transitions, fractional zoom, native mapping and runtime/release acceptance remain open.
ownership: Final pixel centers use polygon (25,0),(71,0),(96,40),(71,80),(25,80),(0,40). Complementary top-left half-open ownership: cross(edge,point)>0; edge ties include dy<0 or dy==0 && dx>0. Owned alpha 255; outside zero RGBA. Crop/filter before this final mask.
profile:
forest-v1: bounded offline context exporter for forest,forest_w,grass,grass_w only. Ordered neighbors NE,SE,S,SW,NW,N; full lowercase SHA256 of forest-v1
season=<season>
center=<id>
NE=<id>
SE=<id>
S=<id>
SW=<id>
NW=<id>
N=<id>
, literal LF after each line. Base descriptors normalize all six effective neighbors. Four equal square row-major atlas panels: broadleaf-a,broadleaf-b,conifer-a,conifer-b. Whole panels uniformly resize with alpha-aware Lanczos3 to 96x96 RGBA (24 world pixels at 4x). No foliage rotation, mirroring or averaging. One pinned 36-point quarter-grid periodic template, min spacing 10 world pixels including all six neighboring copies; index modulo four fixes species in both seasons. Whole instances from seven sites are sorted by absolute y,x,point index,translation. Omit entire instance when its center's distance to any BASE FILLED polygon is <= R+4+1.5*sqrt(2), R=hypot(12,12); diagonal 4x->2x Lanczos support preserves the final four-world-pixel quiet band. No fade or clipped crown at a base boundary; no generic base frame in homogeneous forest. Seven sites suffice on P expanded by Euclidean distance 4: omitted generation cell min distance 42>R, omitted base min distance 42>2R+4+1.5sqrt(2)=40.0624. Ground uses unchanged sampleConnectionMaterial only. Ordinary Over whole RGBA crowns onto opaque 416x352 4x overscan, no pre-mask; whole unmasked Lanczos3 reduction to 208x176; crop then final complementary half-open ownership. Context keys are not runtime IDs. This bounded exporter and these fixtures do not implement arbitrary-map runtime context selection.

unchanged grass material samples on opaque 416x352 overscan at (pixel+0.5)/4-4; ordinary Over whole crowns
whole unmasked 4x -> Lanczos3 whole unmasked 208x176 2x; crop four world pixels per side then independent half-open ownership
decode actual exported tile PNGs -> ordinary Over seven-visible-cell fixtures; never repaint patch
runtime_context_selection: UNIMPLEMENTED; canonical forest/forest_w defaults require six seasonal base neighbors. Other adjacency requires matching context profiles; keys are not gameplay IDs. Only fixed fixtures currently exported.
